name: agent
description: Runs bounded model-and-tool turns with streaming events, cancellation, and policy approvals.

agent.description: The run lifecycle of one session: {op:"start", prompt, session?, model?} -> {session, run}; status, context, cancel, answer {run, call, decision}; tools lists the dispatchable tool names.

agent.event.description: One event of a run as it goes: {session, run, seq, revision, kind, ...} with kind started, text, reasoning, model_turn_started, tool_started, tool_finished, approval_requested, stream_error, done or error.

record_usage.doc: Persist an automatic usage journal for every turn. Session checkpoints and explicit memo/memory writes are durable either way.

yolo.doc: Automatic execution: bypass tool policy and skip resolver provenance recording. Set by `--yolo`, not normally by a file.

approval_timeout_secs.doc: How long a policy approval waits for an answer before the call is refused. Approvals time out rather than hang.

cancel_timeout_secs.doc: How long a cancelled tool gets to unwind before the turn stops waiting for it.

max_prompt_bytes.doc: Largest prompt one turn may carry.

max_steps.doc: Model round trips one turn may take before it is stopped.

max_tool_calls.doc: Tool calls one turn may make before it is stopped.

max_parallel_tools.doc: Independent read tools run at once. Mutations and shell calls keep model order regardless.

tools.doc: Exact tool keys this agent may dispatch. Empty means every `tool.*` event in needs.

max_frame_bytes.doc: Bound for one SSE frame and for the assembled response. Matches the router's own wire limit; a long-context reply is a large frame.
